request.style: English, Latin worship bachata, sweet requinto guitar, bongos and güira, a tender male lead with a female harmony, swaying dance rhythm, 128 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sing to the Lord a new song
His praise in the assembly of the faithful
Let Israel be glad in its Maker
Let the children of Zion rejoice in their King

[Chorus]
Praise his name with dancing
Make music with tambourine and lyre
For the Lord takes pleasure in his people
He crowns the humble with salvation

[Verse]
Let the faithful exult in glory
Let them sing for joy upon their beds
With the high praises of God in their mouths
Let them dance before the King

[Chorus]
Praise his name with dancing
Make music with tambourine and lyre
For the Lord takes pleasure in his people
He crowns the humble with salvation
